lesson_title: Macro Essentials: The Whole Macro Year in One Taxi Ride
hook_text: The entire macro syllabus is one taxi route. Get in — this ride takes four minutes.
clip_script: Picture your town's economy as its taxi route. Households board with their labour; businesses pay wages; the wages ride back to the shops; the shops pay wages again. Money circles — that is the circular flow. Money saved, taxed or spent on imports gets OFF the route: leakages. Investment, government spending, exports get ON: injections. Route steady when off equals on — equilibrium. Now one big passenger boards: a firm builds an eight million rand depot. People spend seventy-five cents of every rand, so divide one by the twenty-five cents that leak — multiplier four. Eight million becomes thirty-two million around town. The year on the route: busy season, peak, quiet months, trough — the business cycle around a rising trend. The government's purse: tax in, schools and grants out — and the tuckshop truth of the Laffer curve: price at nothing, till empty; price too high, till empty; the best rate sits between. And the rand? Just a price at a stall — many buyers of foreign money, few sellers, and the rand weakens. One route, one purse, one stall. That is macro. Now go collect its marks.
visual_style: A minibus taxi looping a hand-drawn town map with coins hopping on and off; a depot stamping R8m that ripples into R32m; a wave rising through seasons; a purse filling and emptying; a street stall with two queues trading rands for foreign notes.
mood: Warm, local, revelatory — the year clicking into one picture.
pacing: A steady narrative ride with beat pauses at each landmark: flow, multiplier, cycle, purse, stall.
call_to_action: Take the full ride — the whole macro year in one revision session.
